_what: Run 2's save edit E-EVO (approved by snatcherLeo, 2026-10-20), for the postgame evolution sitting EVO after Ho-Oh (playthrough-guide.md part 7, 'Evolution: every method'). Pokemon (legal, checked against the disc): two Wurmple Lv 6, one per personality split (Silcoon, kind 11; Cascoon, kind 12), Nincada Lv 19 (Ninjask, kind 4, plus Shedinja, kind 14, which needs a free party slot), Feebas Lv 5 with Beauty 170 (kind 15; Beauty normally comes from Pokeblocks, which Colosseum doesn't have). Rare Candies: E1's x99 (no candy line here: a recipe sets a count). EVO must start with ONE Pokemon in the party, so after the four are added one slot stays free for Shedinja.

add_pokemon._note: Wurmple: Tackle, String Shot, Poison Sting; (personality >> 16) % 10 < 5 -> Silcoon at Lv 7
Wurmple: the same; % 10 >= 5 -> Cascoon at Lv 7
Nincada: Scratch, Harden, Leech Life; Lv 20 -> Ninjask, plus Shedinja into the free slot
Feebas: Splash; Beauty 170 -> Milotic on its next level-up
